places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat and Ganga Aarti
places.description: The Dashashwamedh Ganga Aarti is the single most magnificent ritual spectacle in India.

places.name: Pre-dawn Boat Ride on the Ganges
places.description: The sunrise boat ride on the Ganges past Varanasi's ghats is one of the most profound travel experiences on earth.
places.mapsSearch: boat ride Varanasi ghats Ganges sunrise
places.bestTime: Pre-dawn to one hour after sunrise

places.name: Manikarnika Ghat (Cremation Ghat)
places.description: No other place confronts the impermanence of life as honestly and as openly as Manikarnika Ghat.
places.bestTime: Early morning for a respectful, quieter observation

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
places.description: The spiritual energy within Kashi Vishwanath, one of Hinduism's most sacred shrines, is unlike any other place.
places.bestTime: Pre-dawn mangala aarti, or evening shringar aarti at 7 PM

places.name: Assi Ghat
places.description: The most intellectually alive ghat in Varanasi — philosophy, yoga, debate, and great chai all at the river's edge.
places.bestTime: Sunrise for puja, any time for atmosphere

places.name: Sarnath
places.description: Sarnath is where Buddhism was born — the spot holds immense spiritual significance for over 500 million people worldwide.

places.name: Varanasi Ghats Walk (All 84 Ghats)
places.description: Walking all 84 ghats is the most complete and intense immersion in Varanasi's living culture possible.
places.mapsSearch: Varanasi ghats walk Assi to Raj Ghat
places.bestTime: Morning, starting at sunrise from Assi

places.name: Banaras Hindu University and Bharat Kala Bhavan
places.description: The Bharat Kala Bhavan holds some of the finest Indian miniature paintings in the world, and almost no tourists visit.
places.mapsSearch: Bharat Kala Bhavan BHU Varanasi museum

places.name: Ramnagar Fort and Museum
places.description: The fort museum's eclectic royal collection — cars, weapons, howdahs — offers an intimate picture of Varanasi's princely past.

places.name: Tulsi Manas Temple
places.description: The temple built on the spot where the Ramcharitmanas was composed connects visitors directly to one of India's greatest literary creations.

budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
